subject: Converting ClearSky to Marketplace billing — steps + PO
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@clearsky.io>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace billing question ahead of renewal

Hi Hannah —

We're coming up on our annual renewal with Redwood (renewal date 2027-06-15) and procurement is trying to move all purchases onto AWS Marketplace for our internal controls and consolidated billing. Can you confirm whether ClearSky can convert our Redwood contract to AWS Marketplace billing and still keep the same committed unit price? If so, what steps do you need from us (PO, signed private offer, etc.) and how long does the switch typically take?

Quick context: current seat-based commitment (QPS) under direct agreement. We have a PO team that prefers a Marketplace private offer and needs an estimated invoice date for budget planning.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call.

Sarah Kim
Senior Procurement Manager
ClearSky Analytics
procurement@clearsky.io
+1 415-555-0182

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: david.kim@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace billing question ahead of renewal

Looping you both in — ClearSky wants to move onto AWS Marketplace prior to the 6/15 renewal. They want pricing parity and a clear timeline for invoice/PO processing.

Ask: can we convert the direct contract to a Marketplace Private Offer without disrupting the renewal? Dylan — can you propose the migration steps and timing (I think we need finance + marketplace ops sign-off). Marissa — any co-sell/rebate considerations we can offer to ease procurement?

Attaching the original procurement note below. I can join any call.

Thanks,
Hannah
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 510-555-0123

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: david.kim@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace billing question ahead of renewal

Thanks Hannah — quick outline below. I spoke with Marketplace Ops and Finance this morning.

1) Feasibility: yes, we can do an AWS Marketplace Private Offer that maps to the same effective unit price. We need a new listing/offer configured and a Private Offer created in AWS tied to ClearSky's AWS Account (requires their AWS Account ID).

2) Required from ClearSky:
- AWS Account ID for the Private Offer
- Signed Private Offer (DocuSign) OR PO referencing the Private Offer ID
- Confirmation they want billing to move to Marketplace as of invoice date X (we should propose 6/15 renewal invoice date)

3) Internal steps:
- Finance to approve price parity and create offer record (1 business day)
- Marketplace Ops to create private offer in AWS (2-3 business days)
- DocuSign -> customer signs private offer (1-3 business days depending on procurement)
- Raise billing change in our billing system and set first Marketplace invoice date

I attached a short "marketplace-pricing-summary.pdf" showing parity and a migration SOW draft (MAP_Migration_SOW.docx) that outlines timelines and responsibilities.

Proposed timeline if we start next week: private offer live by 05/26, signed by 06/03, billing flows via Marketplace for the 06/15 invoice. If procurement needs a later invoice date we can adjust.

I'll handle ops coordination and will need Finance (David) to sign off on the mapping.

—Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: david.kim@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace billing question ahead of renewal

Great, thanks. A couple of product/GTMS notes:

- Co-sell / Marketplace incentives: We can offer to list ClearSky on our co-sell collateral and provide a 5% Marketplace rebate (applied to the first 6 months' Marketplace invoices) to help purchase approval. This needs approval from RevOps but is a common concession for committed customers moving to marketplace.
- Ask Procurement to include the Private Offer ID on the PO so our billing team can match it automatically.
- I'll prepare a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to send to ClearSky with milestones: AWS Account ID > Private Offer created > DocuSign completed > First Marketplace invoice date.

Draft MAP (quick):
- 5/24: ClearSky provides AWS Account ID + PO draft
- 5/26: Redwood creates Private Offer in AWS + sends DocuSign
- 6/03: ClearSky returns signed Private Offer / PO
- 6/15: First Marketplace invoice issued

I'll also paste HubSpot deal link for the finance team: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/45721 — please update deal stage to "Marketplace Migration".

Marissa
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

1) AWS Account ID: 111122223333
2) We will attach our PO (ACME_PO_98765.pdf) and would like the Private Offer ID included on the final invoice.
3) Can the Marketplace rebate be documented in the Private Offer or will it be a separate credit? Procurement needs that for internal approval.

We'd like to keep the 6/15 invoice date if possible. Please share the DocuSign link for the Private Offer when it's ready.

-sarah

- 5/26: Private Offer + DocuSign to ClearSky. We will include language in the Private Offer (note on DocuSign) documenting the 5% Marketplace rebate as a separate credit line that will appear on invoices for the first 6 months. RegOps/Finance (David) will approve final phrasing.
- 6/03: Target signed Private Offer / PO returned.
- 6/15: We will make the first Marketplace invoice.

Dylan — can you confirm once the DocuSign is live and paste the link here? David — can you confirm revenue/rebate flow for bookkeeping?

I'll update the HubSpot deal to "Marketplace Migration" and attach the PO.

Best,
Hannah
